getFIX(x, getINFO = FALSE)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Extract fix and genotype data from VCF and calculate VAF

results <- lapply(all_content.sv, function(vcf_obj) {
  # Step 1: Extract fixed fields
  fix_data <- getFIX(vcf_obj,getINFO = TRUE)
  
  # Convert to a data frame for easier handling
  df_fix <- as.data.frame(fix_data)
  
  # Rename columns if needed (optional)
  colnames(df_fix) <- c("CHROM", "POS", "ID", "REF", "ALT", "QUAL", "FILTER", "INFO")
  
  # Extract the INFO column as a character vector
info_column <- as.character(df_fix$INFO)

# Function to extract specific variables from the INFO column
extract_info <- function(info, key) {
  pattern <- paste0(key, "=([^;]+)")  # Regex pattern to match key=value
  matches <- regexpr(pattern, info)  # Find matches
  
  # Extract matched strings or return NA where no match is found
  values <- ifelse(matches > 0, regmatches(info, matches), NA)
  values <- sub(paste0(key, "="), "", values)  # Remove "key=" to keep only the value
  
  return(values)
}

# Extract specific fields from INFO and rename columns
df_fix$precise_breakpoint <- ifelse(grepl("^PRECISE", info_column), "PRECISE", NA)
df_fix$SV_TYPE <- extract_info(info_column, "SVTYPE")
df_fix$SVLEN <- extract_info(info_column, "SVLEN")
df_fix$END <- extract_info(info_column, "END")
df_fix$CHR2 <- extract_info(info_column, "CHR2")
df_fix$STRAND <- extract_info(info_column, "STRAND")
df_fix$CLNVC <- extract_info(info_column, "CLNVC")
df_fix$GENEINFO <- extract_info(info_column, "GENEINFO")
df_fix$ANN <- extract_info(info_column, "ANN")
df_fix$LOF <- extract_info(info_column, "LOF")
df_fix$NMD <- extract_info(info_column, "NMD")

# Ensure all extracted columns match the number of rows in df_fix
stopifnot(nrow(df_fix) == length(df_fix$SVLEN))  # Check for SVLEN as an example

   # Step 2: Extract genotype fields (GT, DR, DV)
  gt_data <- extract.gt(vcf_obj, element = "GT")  # Genotype
  #gq_data <- extract.gt(vcf_obj, element = "GQ")  # Genotype quality
  dr_data <- extract.gt(vcf_obj, element = "DR")  # Reference reads
  dv_data <- extract.gt(vcf_obj, element = "DV")  # Variant reads
 
  # Step 3: Calculate VAF
  # Convert DR and DV to numeric
  dr_numeric <- apply(dr_data, 2, as.numeric)  # Convert DR to numeric
  dv_numeric <- apply(dv_data, 2, as.numeric)  # Convert DV to numeric
  # Calculate Variant Allele Frequency (VAF = DV / (DR + DV))
  vaf <- dv_numeric / (dr_numeric + dv_numeric)
  
 # Step 4: Combine fixed fields, genotype data, and VAF
  combined_df <- cbind(
    df_fix,                 # Fixed fields
    GT = as.character(gt_data),           # Genotype data
   DR = as.numeric(dr_data),         # Reference reads
   DV = as.numeric(dv_data),        # Variant reads
  VAF = as.numeric(vaf)           # Variant Allele Frequency
  )
 colnames(combined_df)[(ncol(df_fix) + 1):ncol(combined_df)] <- c("GT", "DR", "DV", "VAF")
  return(combined_df)  # Return the combined data frame
})



```



```{r, echo=FALSE}
# unlist all lists and change column name
all_result <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results), function(name) {
  # Extract each sub-list, add a name column, and return as data frame
  cbind(sample_name = name, results[[name]])
}))
fwrite(all_result, "SV_four_samples.csv")

all_result2 <- all_result %>% dplyr::select(c("sample_name","CHROM",  "POS" ,
    "ID" ,  "REF" ,"ALT" ,  "QUAL" ,  "FILTER" ,"SV_TYPE" ,  "END"  ,"CHR2","STRAND" , "GT"  ,   "DR",
```
